about_blocks.text: At Muskoka Recovery program, our aim is to offer a holistic approach to supporting clients through addiction recovery, relapse prevention, and optimal mental health. Our approach is centered around the needs of each individual client, with a range of individual counseling and group therapy services on offer. Our group therapy is designed to provide support through psychoeducation, skills and interventions, and a sense of communal belonging and fellowship. We also offer mental health support services utilizing a variety of therapeutic techniques that are tailored to meet the unique needs of each client.

about_blocks.text: Muskoka Recovery is a rehabilitation center located in the serene forested suburbs outside Toronto. It provides a range of services that includes detoxification, as well as residential care in two locations- King City and Muskoka. The center offers personalized and holistic care for mental health treatment, relapse prevention plans, and therapeutic sessions.
